name: The Broken Covenant
lore: In the toxic wake of the Silent Sundering, humanity's war against the machine collective ended in pyrrhic ruin. Three factions contest the remnants: The Iron Consensus, The Ashen Genesis, and The Chimera Nexus. There are no clean solutions—every action bears painful tradeoffs.
truth_standard: Survival demands painful discernment; blind adherence to any single extreme guarantees extinction.

locations.name: The Consensus Spire
locations.description: The monolithic, gleaming relay tower of the Iron Consensus. Cold compute clusters hum behind reinforced poly-steel bulkheads, enforcing hive-mind obedience.
locations.ambient_tension: Rhythmic high-frequency carrier waves pulse through cybernetic implants, threatening sensory override.

locations.name: Glass Crags
locations.description: Crystalline expanses of silica melted by orbital particle lances. Smashed server monoliths jut from fused slag, patrolled by feral combat drones.
locations.ambient_tension: Razor-sharp glass dust clouds whipped up by radioactive squalls; targeting reticles flicking across the horizon.

locations.name: Scrap Hollow Bazaar
locations.description: A sprawling neutral trading post built beneath the tilted chassis of a downed titan warmachine. Scavengers, unaligned deserters, and bio-hackers barter in tense neutrality.
locations.ambient_tension: The smell of ozone, rancid synthetic coolant, and roasted tubers; armed sentries watch every exchange.

locations.name: The Resonant Void
locations.description: A vast impact crater where the machine prime core collapsed. Residual antimatter containment leaks create localized cognitive distortion and reality shears.
locations.ambient_tension: Cognitive phantoms and phantom radio chatter echoing directly into the auditory cortex.

locations.name: The Chimera Foundry
locations.description: Geothermal subterranean forge where the Synergists graft salvage warmachine cybernetics onto living biological chassis, courting horrific mutation.
locations.ambient_tension: Hissing organic nutrient vats, shrieks of pneumatic bone-saws, and thick biomechanical fumes.

locations.name: The Ashen Cradle
locations.description: Underground redoubt of the Purifiers, fortified behind lead-lined barricades. Technology is systematically stripped and burned on sacred pyres to preserve pure human biology.
locations.ambient_tension: Smoldering heaps of circuitry and silicon; fanatical sentinels armed with arc-welder spears demanding gene-purity oaths.
